shed-skin.shortEffect: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.
shed-skin.effect: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 33% of being cured of any major status ailment.
shed-skin.flavor: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

run-away.shortEffect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
run-away.effect: This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability.
run-away.flavor: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

tackle.name: Tackle
tackle.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

growl.name: Growl
growl.shortEffect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
growl.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

struggle-bug.name: Struggle Bug
struggle-bug.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
struggle-bug.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

bug-bite.name: Bug Bite
bug-bite.shortEffect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
bug-bite.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately. If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect. If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

endeavor.name: Endeavor
endeavor.shortEffect: Lowers the target’s HP to equal the user’s.
endeavor.effect: Inflicts exactly enough damage to lower the target’s HP to equal the user’s. If the target’s HP is not higher than the user’s, this move has no effect. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This effect counts as damage for moves that respond to damage.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.shortEffect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
lunge.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

skitter-smack.name: Skitter Smack
skitter-smack.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
